reviewBeforeUse: These are operator reference scripts only. StayXI does not provide phone answering or place phone calls. Replace all bracketed fields with current, host-approved details before an operator uses any wording. Never put real access credentials in a sample file or public repository.

answerPhone.greeting: Hello, [OPERATOR_OR_PROPERTY_NAME]. This is [HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME]. How can I help?
answerPhone.afterHours: You've reached [OPERATOR_OR_PROPERTY_NAME]. Our current availability is [CONFIRMED_HOURS]. For urgent property concerns, use [CONFIRMED_URGENT_CONTACT]. For immediate danger, call 911.
answerPhone.takingMessage: Please leave your name, callback number, property, and a brief description. [HOST_OR_OPERATOR_NAME] will respond according to [CONFIRMED_RESPONSE_EXPECTATIONS].

accessCodeInquiry.reply: For your security, access instructions are shared only through the verified booking channel. Please check your reservation message or contact your host directly.
accessCodeInquiry.alternative: If you are unable to enter the property, use [CONFIRMED_URGENT_CONTACT]. If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911.

wifiInquiry.reply: Please check the host-approved welcome information at the property or in your booking message for Wi-Fi details.
wifiInquiry.alternative: If you cannot connect, contact [CONFIRMED_HOST_CONTACT]. Do not send account passwords in a public or unverified channel.

propertyIssue.reply: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. I can’t verify or resolve it by phone. Please contact [CONFIRMED_HOST_CONTACT] and follow the property’s posted safety instructions.
propertyIssue.alternative: If anyone is in immediate danger, move to safety and call 911. StayXI is not emergency dispatch.

helpInquiry.reply: This is the guest contact line for [OPERATOR_OR_PROPERTY_NAME]. For property questions, use [CONFIRMED_CONTACT_METHOD]. Reply STOP to opt out of SMS.
helpInquiry.alternative: For help with an active reservation, use the contact details in your booking confirmation.

stopInquiry.reply: You've been unsubscribed and will receive no further messages. Reply START to resubscribe.
stopInquiry.alternative: Do not send any further marketing or guest messages unless the recipient opts back in.

helpInfoInquiry.reply: This is [OPERATOR_OR_PROPERTY_NAME]'s automated guest text line. It provides limited property information and is not emergency support. Reply STOP to opt out.
helpInfoInquiry.alternative: For an urgent property issue use [CONFIRMED_HOST_CONTACT]; call 911 for immediate danger.
